content: Raptive lowered its minimum from 100k to 25,000 monthly pageviews (Oct 16, 2025) -- now potentially reachable for ParseForge at 30-50k. Mediavine's main platform now requires ,000/yr ad earnings (revenue-based, not pageview-based) rather than the old 50k-session threshold; Journey by Mediavine (smaller-site tier) needs only ~1,000 sessions/mo. Ezoic reportedly has no minimum traffic requirement in most sources (3,000 visits can qualify) though one 2026 source claims Ezoic raised to 250k/mo -- conflicting, verify directly at signup.
